selection: All four NER-complete round37 TRAIN abstracts containing explicitly named DATASET entities. Previously locked train sources; no new collection, dev/test error targeting, model-score sampling or document replacement.
goal: Reduce relation-label sparsity and inverse-argument mistakes without changing source NER. Add source-supported task/benchmark edges and specific receiver-versus-operator contrasts; do not equate component use with independent component evaluation.
entityPolicy: All 58 source references, entity spans/status/reasons/group mentions remain unchanged; inherit non-revised receipts and previously resolved labels. Eight NER quarantines remain excluded, not all-O. Partial resolved pairs are usable only within complete NER documents.
positivePolicy: Explicit local operator/task or named-method/benchmark attribution. Repeated proper names may refer to the same named method when the source makes the connection; count their spans but disclose correlated aliases. An evaluation of our approach alone cannot certify that each named internal component was independently evaluated.
negativePolicy: Use only the parent's explicit_argument_role_contrast or explicit_dataset_use_contrast with literal evidence and a specific source-role explanation. An unknown pair, missing measurement, training mention, poor performance, common co-occurrence or unsupported benchmark is not a negative.
reviewPolicy: Fresh generation plus actual same-session whole-source/pair self-review on four revised documents, with upstream receipt binding; AI pseudo labels, not independent human gold. Preserve every other receipt unchanged.
experiment: Offline relation-label enrichment and strict NER/marked-pair encoding preflight only. No model training/inference, new scores, dev relabeling, reserved-test consumption or production mutation. A future training experiment needs its own locked input and configuration.
